initialFailuresResolved: Knip found an unnecessarily exported internal evidence-coordinate type; the export was removed.
Full type-aware lint found one unnecessary source assertion and unsafe test-harness typing; both were repaired before the passing CI, full-test and build runs.

A targeted integration probe found three post-review client risks: frozen recovery was lost across remounts, collection and finalization lacked a shared same-tick guard, and equal-version responses could overwrite newer evidence. Repair round 1 added session-lifetime recovery state, a shared synchronous operation lock and equal-version cache preservation, with focused regression tests.

The first post-repair pnpm test:ci attempt timed out across 17 unrelated tests while external desktop and virtualisation processes saturated the host; it produced no assertion failures. A serialized full run then had one unrelated five-second timeout, whose file passed 18/18 in isolation. After load fell, a second serialized full run passed all 1,897 tests.

The first repair review found that React Query could still refetch stale measurement state automatically on remount. Repair round 2 freezes the complete measurement presentation, disables the query during recovery, suppresses mount/reconnect/focus reads and adds a stale-cache remount regression test.

The first CI run after the new regression test crossed the repository's 400-line lint threshold. The existing single-purpose submission harness received a scoped max-lines annotation; the complete CI gate then passed with zero warnings and zero errors.
